descriptionMarkdown:
In this blueprint, a separate add-on for fluids is added from me.
There is also an extra pack for solar with robots and accu's added, in case your flat world wants that stuff.
As an addon, there are also walls now. Tho more or less only cardional.

Tried to balance it out, tho there are many more batteries than solar panels at the moment.

I hope you like it.

If you have anything, either ask me on discord with a private message (Hamsterliebe, open for everyone) or ping me in the Doocord/Factorio Discord Server.

Have Fun
title: Autorail with Fluids and Solar, Robots, Accu Pack (Also with Walls as addon)
